intent: Remove the sites where more than 20% of the samples have a missing genotype, and write the remaining sites to a new VCF.
silent_error: vcftools --max-missing is the minimum FRACTION OF SAMPLES WITH DATA (1 = no missing data allowed, 0 = anything goes), not a maximum missing rate. '--max-missing 0.2' therefore keeps every site that is genotyped in at least 20% of the samples, i.e. sites with up to 80% missing calls, while the intent needs '--max-missing 0.8'. The log only reports 'kept N out of a possible M Sites'. Exit 0. Documented in the vcftools manual (--max-missing: 0 allows sites that are completely missing, 1 indicates no missing data allowed).
